# Copilot Instructions

This document contains instructions for using GitHub Copilot effectively.

## General Guidelines
- Use clear and concise comments to guide Copilot.
- Experiment with different prompts to get the best suggestions.
- Review suggestions carefully before accepting them.

## Specific Use Cases
- For code completion, start typing the function name and wait for suggestions.
- Use Copilot for boilerplate code generation by providing context in comments.
